nodes.name: spreadsheet_xlsx_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for spreadsheet range/patch helpers, covering absolute-offset row conversion, dimension detection, and sparse patch application for XLSX editing.

nodes.name: range_to_rows_preserves_absolute_offsets
nodes.summary: Test asserting that converting a cell Range to rows preserves absolute sheet offsets rather than re-basing to zero.

nodes.name: read_rows_from_range_returns_requested_absolute_page
nodes.summary: Test asserting that reading a page of rows from a range returns the requested absolute page of data.

nodes.name: group_patches_by_sheet_overwrites_duplicate_cell_with_last_value
nodes.summary: Test asserting that grouping cell patches by sheet keeps only the last value when the same cell is patched twice.

nodes.name: apply_sheet_patches_expands_sparse_rows_and_columns
nodes.summary: Test asserting that applying sheet patches correctly expands sparse row/column maps to fit the patched cells.

nodes.name: main.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri binary entry point that dispatches to the session-provenance hook-capture CLI path when invoked with the capture-hook-stdin argument, otherwise starts the desktop app via app_lib::run.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Process entry point: parses the second CLI argument, routes to capture_hook_stdin for the agent-hook capture mode, or falls through to launching the Tauri app.

nodes.name: approval_gate.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the permission-request approval gate for agent hooks: detects PermissionRequest hook payloads, posts them to the local approval HTTP endpoint, and parses the allow/deny decision response.

nodes.name: maybe_block_for_permission_decision
nodes.summary: Checks whether a hook payload is a permission request and, if so, blocks synchronously on posting it to the approval endpoint, returning a stdout decision JSON string.

nodes.name: post_approval_request
nodes.summary: Opens a raw TCP connection to the local status/approval endpoint, sends the request body, and reads back the raw HTTP response bytes.

nodes.name: parse_decision_response
nodes.summary: Parses a raw HTTP response into a decision string, extracting and JSON-decoding the response body.

nodes.name: collaboration_replay.rs
nodes.summary: Indexes and deletes collaboration-replay session provenance records, converting cached agent events into persisted interactions and remapping file paths between a source and local workspace.

nodes.name: index_collaboration_replay
nodes.summary: Loads cached session metadata and events for a collaboration replay, upserts the session record, and persists each event as a resource/file interaction transactionally.

nodes.name: delete_collaboration_replay
nodes.summary: Removes a collaboration replay's session provenance records from the local store by local session ID.

nodes.name: remap_collaboration_file_path
nodes.summary: Remaps a file path captured in a source workspace onto the equivalent path in the local workspace, preserving relative structure.

nodes.name: historical_backfill.rs
nodes.summary: Runs an async background job that backfills historical session interaction data for a repository, tracking job state (queued/discovering/indexing/complete/failed) and reconciling imported and native sessions against priority files.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a leased job-claim pattern in SQLite (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT with a run-token) to prevent duplicate concurrent backfill runs across processes.

nodes.name: HistoricalBackfillJob
nodes.summary: Represents the persisted state of a historical backfill job: status, session counters, last error, run token, and update timestamp.

nodes.name: HistoricalBackfillStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of backfill job lifecycle states: Queued, Discovering, Indexing, Complete, Partial, Failed.

nodes.name: request_historical_backfill
nodes.summary: Public entry point that canonicalizes a repo path, checks whether backfill is needed for a priority file, and spawns a background thread to run reconciliation while tracking job progress.

nodes.name: claim_backfill_job
nodes.summary: Atomically claims or refreshes the backfill job lease for a repo key using a run-token, avoiding duplicate concurrent backfills.

nodes.name: load_backfill_job
nodes.summary: Loads the current HistoricalBackfillJob row for a repo key from the database, if one exists.

nodes.name: update_backfill_job
nodes.summary: Updates progress counters and status for an in-flight backfill job row, guarded by the run token.

nodes.name: finish_backfill_job
nodes.summary: Marks a backfill job as complete for the given repo key and run token.

nodes.name: fail_backfill_job
nodes.summary: Marks a backfill job as failed for the given repo key and run token, recording the error message.

nodes.name: reconcile_historical_interactions
nodes.summary: Core reconciliation loop that walks imported and native sessions touching a priority file and updates progress counters as it backfills each.

nodes.name: sync_imported_history_caches
nodes.summary: Refreshes cached imported-history indexes so subsequent session lookups reflect the latest reconciled state.

nodes.name: imported_sessions_for_repo
nodes.summary: Queries imported sessions for a given source and canonical repo path.

nodes.name: session_touches_priority_file
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given imported session touched the specified priority file within the canonical repo.

nodes.name: priority_file_needs_backfill
nodes.summary: Decides whether the backlog for a priority file still needs backfilling by checking existing coverage against native and imported sessions.

nodes.name: backlog_sessions_needing_work
nodes.summary: Selects a limited batch of backlog sessions still needing reconciliation work.

nodes.name: reconcile_imported_session
nodes.summary: Reconciles a single imported (cloud-sourced) session into local activity chunks and persists them via persist_activity_chunks.

nodes.name: native_sessions_for_repo
nodes.summary: Queries native (locally captured) sessions for a given repo path and canonical repo identifier.

nodes.name: reconcile_native_session
nodes.summary: Reconciles a single native session's activity chunks into the interaction store via persist_activity_chunks.

nodes.name: hook_capture.rs
nodes.summary: Captures agent-hook stdin payloads (resource interactions, actor lifecycle events, status posts, permission requests), spools them to a durable inbox, and drains that inbox on a background loop into persistent storage.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a write-temp-then-rename spool pattern for crash-safe envelope persistence before async draining.

nodes.name: capture_hook_stdin
nodes.summary: Reads a hook envelope JSON payload from stdin, dispatches status/actor-lifecycle events, checks the approval gate for permission requests, and writes the decision back to stdout.

nodes.name: recent_signals
nodes.summary: Drains the hook inbox and returns the most recent hook signals up to a bounded limit, run on a blocking task.

nodes.name: spool_envelope
nodes.summary: Validates and writes a resource interaction envelope to the durable hook inbox.

nodes.name: spool_actor_lifecycle
nodes.summary: Validates and writes an actor lifecycle envelope to the durable hook inbox.

nodes.name: spool_bytes
nodes.summary: Writes raw envelope bytes to the inbox directory using a write-temp-then-rename pattern for crash safety, skipping duplicates.

nodes.name: drain_hook_inbox
nodes.summary: Drains queued envelope files from the inbox under a process-wide lock, persisting valid ones and quarantining invalid ones.

nodes.name: quarantine_invalid_envelope
nodes.summary: Moves an envelope file that failed validation into a rejected/ subdirectory instead of deleting it.

nodes.name: spawn_hook_inbox_drain_loop
nodes.summary: Spawns a background Tauri async task that periodically drains the hook inbox and emits an event to the frontend.

nodes.name: interaction_store.rs
nodes.summary: Persists native agent event interactions and activity chunks (file edits, resource interactions) into the session provenance record store, resolving file paths and deriving stable interaction IDs.

nodes.name: persist_native_event_interactions
nodes.summary: Converts a native agent event into resource/file interactions and persists them for the given session and turn.

nodes.name: persist_activity_chunks
nodes.summary: Persists a batch of activity chunks for a session, source, and workspace into the interaction store with a given attribution precision.

nodes.name: cached_event_to_activity_chunk
nodes.summary: Converts a cached session event record into an activity chunk suitable for interaction persistence.

nodes.name: persist_file_interaction
nodes.summary: Resolves a file path to a repo resource and persists a single file interaction record with actor, outcome, and capture-method metadata.

nodes.name: resource_interaction_id
nodes.summary: Derives a stable, deterministic interaction ID from source, session, actor, resource, action, and timestamp fields.

nodes.name: path_resolution.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves working directories to git repositories and files to canonical repo-relative paths, with a cache for repeated repo lookups and lexical (non-filesystem-touching) path canonicalization.
nodes.languageNotes: Manually walks .git / gitdir-file / commondir indirection to support worktrees without shelling out to git.

nodes.name: resolve_repo_for_cwd
nodes.summary: Resolves and caches the git repository (workspace and record ID) for a given working directory.

nodes.name: discover_git_repo
nodes.summary: Walks up from a starting directory to locate the git worktree root and common directory, handling worktree gitdir indirection files.

nodes.name: resolve_file_resource
nodes.summary: Resolves a file path relative to a working directory into a ResolvedFileResource with repository ID, workspace path, and display path.

nodes.name: absolute_lexical_path
nodes.summary: Lexically resolves a path against a base directory into an absolute path without touching the filesystem.

nodes.name: canonicalize_existing_prefix
nodes.summary: Canonicalizes the longest existing prefix of a path, falling back to lexical resolution for the remaining non-existent tail.

nodes.name: ResolvedFileResource
nodes.summary: Data structure capturing a resolved file's repository ID, workspace path, repo-relative path, and display path.

nodes.name: status_post.rs
nodes.summary: Minimal HTTP client that reads the local status endpoint file (host/port/token) and posts session status events to it over a raw TCP socket.

nodes.name: read_endpoint
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the local endpoint file containing the version, port, and auth token for the status HTTP endpoint.

nodes.name: post_status_event
nodes.summary: Posts a status event over a raw TCP connection to the locally discovered status endpoint.

nodes.name: EndpointFile
nodes.summary: Data structure representing the on-disk endpoint descriptor: version, port, and auth token.

nodes.name: test_env.rs
nodes.summary: Shared test-only helpers that install and prime an in-memory/sandboxed database schema and expose a raw connection for backend unit tests.

nodes.name: prime_schema
nodes.summary: Primes a fresh sandboxed database with the application schema so tests can run against a realistic connection.

nodes.name: usage_diagnostics_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests validating usage-diagnostics snapshot sanitization at different privacy levels (off/performance-only/default) and the send-queue's unsent-only read behavior.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds a full sample usage-diagnostics snapshot object at a given privacy level for use across the test cases.

nodes.name: performance_only_strips_usage_aggregates
nodes.summary: Test asserting that the performance-only diagnostics level strips usage aggregate fields from the snapshot.

nodes.name: off_keeps_minimal_existence_usage_only
nodes.summary: Test asserting that the off diagnostics level retains only minimal existence-usage data.

nodes.name: default_sanitization_drops_raw_or_path_fields
nodes.summary: Test asserting that default sanitization drops raw content and filesystem path fields from diagnostics snapshots.

nodes.name: queue_reads_only_unsent_and_marks_sent
nodes.summary: Test asserting that the diagnostics send-queue reads only unsent entries and marks them sent afterward.

nodes.name: actionIds.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the ACTION_ID constant registry enumerating every action identifier usable across the app's command/action system.

nodes.name: chatPanelActions.zod.ts
nodes.summary: Zod-validated actions for controlling the chat panel: showing the active station chat, repositioning station chat windows, and switching the model-picker style.

nodes.name: defineEmptyAction
nodes.summary: Helper factory that builds a Zod action definition with an empty input schema for chat-panel commands.
